notes.title: New Update v1.30 !
notes.content:
Happy Summer Sale everyone! 
Thanks to old & new customers!, hope you are having a good year so far.
A small, new update is now live,  here are the changes:

[h1]1.32[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed Controller not working with item menu
[/list]
[h1]1.31b[/h1]
[list]
[*]Skates are now working as intended
[/list]
[h1]1.31[/h1]
[list]
[*]There was an issue with Arcade Games going too fast which is now fixed
[*]Slash sound when pressing space during minigames is now removed
[/list]
[h1]1.30[/h1]
NEW STUFF
[list]
[*]Pup Boy interface updated
[*]New Inventory System / Screen
[*]You can now acquire permanent items and use them whenever you want
[*]Skates are now permanent, but you need to find them first
[*]Dog Whistle - Find this magic whistle and you can use it to warp home from anywhere
[*]New Map screen on Pup Boy
[/list]
IMPROVEMENTS
[list]
[*]Dog urine now splashes when it hits the floor
[*]Small details and graphical improvements around the world
[*]New sound for dog slash
[*]Screen fade added between levels for smoother transition
[/list]
FIXES
[list]
[*]fixed glitch that allowed Dog to get behind Factory
[*]Dogs get tired at a slower rate
[*]Dig Dog Arcade Game Scoring System adjusted 
[/list]
OTHER
[list]
[*]some other small tweaks/details
[/list]
The new city + boat update is still in progress, stay tuned for that later!

I'd also like to mention that my new game, Squirrel Sphere should be out in a few months! More details are found on the greenlight page

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=877722790

Thanks!
-SD

notes.title: News & New Sale for April 17th week!
notes.content:
The indie Gala bundle ended awhile back and I want to thank anyone who bought the game. As well as continued thanks to new and old customers. The game has been on Steam now for about 2 years.

Still working on a new, big update, which has a whole new city and new features, like re-usable items and new property to buy.

A few things about next update:
-Updated Pup Boy with new inventory and Map Screens
-Sail-able Boat with new islands
-New city with tons of new stores and places to visit
-Ability to save Dogs for future use in the cryolab
-New home/apartment to buy
-Saving your current dog
-New places like Bar, Club, Lotto Store
-New items like dog whistle + Dragon Transformation Gem
-Equip  & reuse items (use rollerskates when you want)

There is no ETA for these features, and they may be split into several updates

notes.title: Update 1.25 - 1.26: New PUP Boy, New CPU Dog enhancments, + more!
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7947263/d0566bf67bfc3300a129cabc2eb9bf350def743a.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7947263/bc05380f1a311a49c94e0d08cf2ef9d629b80391.png[/img][/url]
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7947263/dcb02adc4a204a0a80e6247740cb9e8613c466b8.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7947263/5c5af83c4932d4ad56f8a4f851a3f164471855f4.png[/img][/url]

[h1]1.25[/h1]

This Version contains a huge improvement in optimization, RAM, and size, as well as new content. "Simulator" has been dropped from the name. I feel "Domestic Dog" suits the game better, and helps it stand out from the countless game with "simulator" in it.

[h1]NEW STUFF[/h1]
[list]
[*]Dog Party! Host a Dog Party and invite strange dogs into your home (use computer to throw party)
[*]CPU Dog improvements
[list]
[*]more CPU dog variety
[*]more CPU dogs on screen and in more places
[*]Improved their behavior and collision
[/list]
[*]PUP Boy
[list]	
[*]now shows close-up of actual DOG
[*]New animated, customizable background (press space to change BG)
[*]improved option menu graphics
[/list]
[*]Lightning bugs added
[*]Merchant Dog NPCs added to stores
[*]new Toy (top) added
[*]Can now eat KO'd rabbits
[/list]

[h1]ADDED CONTENT[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Several New Breeds, including bubble alien, crate alien, VR coil, and rivet bot
	[*]Few New collars
	[*]Few New 32x32 paintings
[/list]

[h1]OPTIMIZATION:[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Optimized Dog Sprites
	[*]Lighting system optimized and improved
	[*]City and Farm Optimized
	[*]Game now uses much less RAM
	[*]Game now takes up much less space
[/list]
[h1]FIXES[/h1]
[list]
	[*]fixed bacon and poop eating issues with a controller :dog_poop:
[/list]

The next major update will allow you to use the boat to travel to new island and also freeze/save your dog. The boat has been removed for now to prevent confusion. There are many things planned for future updates and i have listened to all your feedback. I hope all enjoy the update, Thanks for playing! :dog_husky:

notes.title: Version 1.20 - Major Bug/Crash Fix
notes.content:
A Major Bug that caused the game to crash during the Dig Dog Arcade Game Is now fixed with version 1.20. Please update, and sorry for any dogs lost during that time. Thanks to those who let me know about this.

[h1]VERSION 1.20[/h1]
FIXES
-Fixed Major Crash-causing bug when playing Dig Dog Arcade
-Fixed the color not properly showing on one of the alien dog's eyelids

IMPROVEMENTS
-Dig Dog Game now scales difficulty with score, & has new Lava graphics

Thanks for playing!

Got any suggestions for future updates?, please post them here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/340340/discussions/0/617328415061272450/

-SD

notes.title: NEW UPDATE : 1.18, 1.19, 1.20
notes.content:
Hey everyone, hope you are enjoying the game. These small updates fix and add a few small things. :dog_husky:. The Major  Dig Dog Crash has been fixed in version 1.20 . Sorry for any dogs lost during that time.

[h1]VERSION 1.20[/h1]

FIXES
[list]
[*]Fixed Major Crash-causing bug when playing Dig Dog Arcade
[*]Fixed the color not properly showing on one of the alien dog's eyelids
[/list]
IMPROVEMENTS
[list]
[*]Dig Dog Game now scales difficulty with score, & has new Lava graphics
[/list]
[h1]VERSION 1.19[/h1]
[list]
[*]Removes the Dogizilla PC game. This wasn't supposed to be added yet and will be added back once finished
[*]Hides mouse pointer once again
[/list]
[h1]VERSION 1.18[/h1]

ADDED
[list]
[*]New Color system. Now 100's of possible dog colors instead of 10
[*]Location Text Popups
[*]New Music Player Interface
[*]Splash FX for urinating into water
[*][strike]New PC game [BROKEN],[/strike] not meant to be added yet
[*]A Few new dog breeds
[*]Vet Sign and Vet Water Basin, and Dog Nurse NPC's
[/list]
FIXES
[list]
[*]fixed issue where some controller users couldn't eat their own poop :dog_poop:
[*]lowered maximum # of urine stains to prevent occasional slowdown
[/list]

As I am working on my new games, Ill continue to update Domestic Dog Simulator. There are a few bigger planned features that may take some time.
Try out the new dog colors and upload a screen, Thanks for playing!

http://www.surrealdistractions.com

-SD

notes.title: To all players/customers : Thanks for the great year!
notes.content:
Just wanted to say thanks to you guys for playing my game(s) and allowing me to keep doing what I love. In 2015, I released my first 2 games on Steam and couldn't be any happier with how it turned out. I'm currently working on a FPS (Trigger Spree) and a 3D platformer (Animal Galaxy) and excited to share more progress and info in the coming months. I'll be posting Greenlight pages for both games soon to gauge community interest on them. ːsquirrel_orangeː ːdog_huskyː

I am also currently adding stuff and fixes to Domestic Dog Simulator, as well as porting to mobile and Linux/Mac. The soundtrack release is also upcoming

--SD
